summary: Iteration 2: Tested new CMS-only features - media upload (POST/GET/DELETE /api/media), account update (name/email uniqueness), password change/reset, expanded content (seo/typography/hero.layout keys), and frontend admin tabs (seo, account) with upload buttons and hero layout controls. All 17 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend flows verified via Playwright: login, all 13 tabs present (including new tab-seo and tab-account), upload-btn on hero, hero-overlay, hero-text-align select, seo-title input with successful Publish reflecting on public <title>, save-profile-btn works and reverts cleanly, reset restores defaults, public site regression clean (nav, hero, floating Call/WhatsApp buttons all present).

minor.issue: Backend sets Cache-Control: 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable' correctly, but the Cloudflare/ingress layer overrides it to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. Images still serve fine but browser cannot cache them. Infra-level issue, backend code is correct.

action_items: Optional: Investigate ingress/CDN cache-control override for /api/media/<id> if long-term browser caching of user-uploaded images is desired (backend header is correct, but a proxy layer strips it).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_account: when body.email == current email, still triggers an update — harmless but could be short-circuited.
server.py password change: 6-char minimum is quite weak; consider raising to 8+ with complexity requirements.
server.py media upload: no rate limiting or virus/type-whitelisting beyond Pillow decode; acceptable for admin-only endpoint but worth documenting.
server.py: still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks - should migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers.
test_credentials: admin@caternation.com / CaterNation@2025 (verified working, password reset back to original after test)
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted transient test media entries; account name/email reverted; password reverted; content reset to defaults post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_caternation_api.py (base) and test_caternation_new.py (media/account/password/seo). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests -v. Admin login page re-renders on mount during /auth/me check - wait ~3s before filling. Reset restores content to defaults including new seo/typography/hero.layout keys. Media Cache-Control header is stripped by ingress (backend sets it correctly).
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional bugs found in this iteration. Only minor infra observation on media Cache-Control being overridden by CDN.
